post_title: Was the fight for H1B and green card worth it
concerns_or_questions_summary: 31-year-old user who came to the US for a master's in 2018, was picked in the H-1B lottery in 2022 on their third attempt, and is now waiting on PERM approval before filing I-140 asks whether the long fight for H-1B and a green card has been worth it for those 5–10 years into the journey, as they feel exhausted, unsettled, and one layoff away from leaving.
